title: Rectangular Lot Acreage Calculator
description: Work out a rectangular lot's acreage from its length and width with the Rectangular Lot Acreage Calculator — square feet to acres, exact. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a classic 100 × 150 ft suburban lot is 15,000 square feet — 0.344 acres, which is why 'a third of an acre' is the honest way to describe most suburban yards.
quick_answer: The Rectangular Lot Acreage Calculator multiplies a rectangular lot's length by its width to get square feet, then divides by 43,560 to give acres. Enter the two sides in feet (or metres) and read the acreage — the listing-sheet calculation, done exactly instead of estimated from the kerb.
